rules.statement: A person holding a general power of attorney from the assignee of an insolvent estate is not entitled to bring an action which an assignee may have brought. Where the attorney, who instituted the action, was himself a creditor of the estate and the relief claimed was on behalf of the general body of creditors, the Court should have permitted the plaintiff to ask for that relief in the alternative capacity, provided the facts in regard to that capacity had been pleaded.
